{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''T-15 Reliability Project''' is a construction natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.deq.nc.gov/news/key-issues/natural-gas-pipeline-projects/t-15-reliability-project|title=deq.nc.gov|website=deq.nc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://appvoices.org/2025/06/05/north-carolina-department-of-environmental-quality-to-hold-public-hearings-on-enbridges-water-quality-permit-application-for-t-15-pipeline/|title=appvoices.org|website=appvoices.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Rockingham County (near Eden), North Carolina to Person County (near Roxboro, Hyco Lake), North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ncnewsline.com/2024/02/21/dominion-plans-new-natural-gas-pipeline-between-eden-and-roxboro/|title=ncnewsline.com|website=ncnewsline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://appvoices.org/2025/06/05/north-carolina-department-of-environmental-quality-to-hold-public-hearings-on-enbridges-water-quality-permit-application-for-t-15-pipeline/|title=appvoices.org|website=appvoices.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
